I went to the doctor, and the doctor said I’m overworked (I’ve been working overtime till 2-3AM for the past 2 months) and needs some rest. I did as I’m told as fowarded her with the information. I got home, took the prescribed medicine and fell asleep. I was shocked when I woke up to find my phone with 2 miscalled and 30 new messages from her giving me work to do from home. I felt it was a little bit unfair of her to give me work while I’m on a sick leave and so I ignored the message and didn’t reply her. So, AITA for not replying her text?
